Dental upholstery

Every surface in
the operatory.

From the patient chair to dentist chairs and dental assistant stools, we restore the pieces your team and patients depend on using precise patterns and materials appropriate for healthcare settings.

Completed patient chairPhoto slot
01

Patient chairs

Full or partial reupholstering for dental treatment chairs, including headrests, backrests, seats, leg rests and arm pads.

  • Treatment chairs
  • Headrests & cushions
  • Arm & leg pads
Dentist chair or dental assistant stoolPhoto slot
02

Dentist & assistant seating

Supportive, cleanable upholstery for dentist chairs and dental assistant stools used throughout the operatory.

  • Dentist chairs
  • Dental assistant stools
  • Saddle stools
Foam or contour repairPhoto slot
03

Repairs & rebuilding

More than a surface change: damaged foam and contours can be rebuilt before new material is fitted.

  • Foam replacement
  • Contour shaping
  • Seam & panel repair
Coordinated clinic finishPhoto slot
04

Practice coordination

Colour selection, scheduling and pickup are planned around the needs of an active dental practice.

  • Brand colour matching
  • Weekend rush options
  • Pickup & delivery
